notes: GP referral to physiotherapy for low back pain. Also carries vital signs, lab results, functional status and a plan of care (context only), and a resolved pneumonia (past problem, 'parantunut'). Four diagnoses fall under the physiotherapy questionnaire's illness checklist (I10, E78.0, E11.9, K21.9) and E66.9 under overweight; M54.5 gives the pain duration. Height, weight and smoking are context only (not in the schema). 'Ei tiedossa olevia lääkeaineallergioita' is a drug-scoped none-known statement.
